# Chalkbeat

> Chalkbeat is a nonprofit news organization providing independent coverage of K-12 education policy, school improvement, and education journalism across major American cities.

Chalkbeat operates regional bureaus covering NYC, Chicago, Denver, Detroit, and Tennessee, with a team of dedicated education reporters and bureau chiefs investigating school policy and district governance. The organization combines investigative journalism with data-driven reporting to hold schools accountable and inform public discourse on education.
